description: This file contains the implementation of the LowOrderFee class, which extends the Controller class in the OpenCart system. It provides methods to display and save configuration settings related to the low order fee extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Low Order Fee extension, including displaying the settings page and handling save actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the Low Order Fee extension, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language and models, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the Low Order Fee extension via AJAX, validates permissions, and responds with success or error message in JSON format.
